faq_join: How do I become a member?

Joining Vertex SACCO is simple and fast: 1. Visit any branch or start here on Telegram. 2. Submit your National ID/Passport copy and 1 passport photo. 3. Pay the registration fee of KSh 1,000 and make your first monthly contribution (min. KSh 500). Once activated, you gain immediate access to SACCO savings plans and credit facilities!
faq_loan: How long does loan processing take & what are the limits?

Loan Processing & Limits Overview: • Emergency Loans: Approved within 24 hours (Up to KSh 100,000 @ 14% p.a.). • School Fees Loans: Processed within 48 hours (@ 12% p.a.). • Normal Development Loans: Reviewed within 3-5 business days. You can borrow up to 3x your total savings balance with a repayment period of up to 36-48 months. All major loans require 3 active member guarantors.
faq_savings: What savings options & dividends do you offer?

Vertex SACCO Savings Products: 🟢 Deposit Shares: Withdrawable monthly deposits used to boost your borrowing limit (up to 3x balance). 🟢 Share Capital: Member equity earning attractive annual dividend payouts (historically 10-12% p.a.). 🟢 Target & Holiday Savings: Flexible goal-based savings earning compound interest.
faq_dividends: How are dividends calculated and paid?

Dividends are declared annually following approval by members at the Annual General Meeting (AGM).

Dividends are calculated based on your average share capital held throughout the financial year and credited directly to your account.
faq_guarantors: What are the rules for loan guarantors?

Any fully registered member with up-to-date monthly contributions can guarantee a loan.

• A guarantor's unattached deposits must cover the guaranteed loan amount.
• Guarantors share responsibility for loan recovery in the event of default.
faq_support: How do I get account help?
Use the 📞 Support button in the main menu. Write your message or upload an attachment, then tap Send Message. Our support desk will reply to you directly in Telegram!
